cd /home/jlapenna/p/agent-lcars-ux-work-sources && gh pr create --reviewer jlapenna --title "fix(console): say every source reported on Agents, Shuttlebay and Work" --body "$(cat <<'EOF'
## Why
The mockup's warnings band (`design/fleet-console.html`, the no-warnings branch) reads **No data warnings · All sources reporting**. In production only Bridge and Inbox say so. Agents, Shuttlebay, Work and /work/schedules show a bare "No data warnings"; Costs would too whenever its session cap isn't hit.

## What
- **Agents, Costs, Shuttlebay:** they already compute a complete warnings list but passed `undefined` when it was empty. The frame then fell back to its no-verdict band (`sourcesChecked={false}`). They now always pass `<DataWarnings warnings={…} />`.
- **Work and Schedules:** the read happens inside the body's Suspense, so the band couldn't vouch for it. Each read is now wrapped in React `cache()`, which keeps it to one request per view. `WorkReadWarnings` (in `work-workspace.tsx`) streams the band's verdict from the same read:
  - a failed read is a warning;
  - a partial scan (`stoppedOn`) is a warning;
  - no grant or invalid filters claim nothing;
  - otherwise the band says "All sources reporting".

  The fallback is today's band, so the text only extends on the same line.

## Verification
- New `work-workspace.test.tsx` covers the four verdict cases.
- The Work, Agents, Costs, Shuttlebay and autoscaler suites pass (178 tests). Typecheck is clean, and lint shows only the pre-existing warning in `agent-activity-panel.tsx`.
- After deploy: read every route's band text in production.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

https://claude.ai/code/session_01M3e8hqz5EbT75xWPGsS42j
EOF
)"; sleep 15; h=$(git rev-parse HEAD); id=$(gh pr view ux/work-sources-verdict --json id -q .id); gh api graphql -f query='mutation($id:ID!,$h:GitObjectID!){enablePullRequestAutoMerge(input:{pullRequestId:$id,expectedHeadOid:$h,mergeMethod:SQUASH}){pullRequest{number autoMergeRequest{enabledAt}}}}' -f id=$id -f h=$h -q .data.enablePullRequestAutoMerge.pullRequest
